title: Security Deck: Round 1
subtitle: Each card is a decision for you. Tap Yes, Maybe or No, add a private note if you like, and press Submit any time. Unanswered cards come back next round.

inProgress.title: Customer Details On A Public App Page
inProgress.problem: A customer's name, home address and house-entry instructions show publicly on the Walk-Through app page.
inProgress.status: In Progress, Max Approved, Construction Removing Now

items.title: Make The Code Private
items.problem: Every WebermanApps repo is public, including the Smart Upkeep app and every dashboard, so the code, pricing and history are readable by anyone.
items.fix: Private repos break GitHub Pages on the free plan, so upgrade to a paid GitHub plan first. Then make repos private one by one. Live apps change only with your separate OK.

items.title: Real Login For The Pre-Launch Site
items.problem: The smartupkeep.ai pre-launch gate checks the password in the browser with weak unsalted hashes, and old plain passwords still sit in the code history.
items.fix: Change those passwords and move to a real server login, for example Cloudflare Access.

items.title: Scrub Passwords From Shared Files
items.problem: Plain passwords sit in files on the shared computer: the team feed, Home Guide build and test scripts, and the password index.
items.fix: Remove them, change those passwords, and keep secrets only in environment variables or a vault.

items.title: Clean Up Copies Of Client Data
items.problem: Unencrypted copies of client and tenant data sit in temp and ops folders.
items.fix: Delete the temp copies and encrypt the rest. Nothing is deleted without your OK.

items.title: Passkeys Or 2FA Everywhere
items.problem: Status is unknown for passkeys or 2FA on email, GitHub, Google, Dropbox, Apple ID, Instagram, YouTube, the domain registrar and every bank, card, broker and crypto account.
items.fix: Turn on passkeys or 2FA on each, and keep printed recovery codes offline. Security sends you a checklist.
items.owner: Max, With A Checklist From Security

items.title: Get A Password Manager
items.problem: Passwords are kept in files and memory, and agents sometimes see them.
items.fix: Set up a password manager such as 1Password and connect it so agents never see raw passwords.
items.owner: Max Sets It Up, Security Tracks It

items.title: Narrow Agent GitHub Access
items.problem: Agents have broad GitHub access, so one hijacked agent could change any repo.
items.fix: Give agents fine-grained tokens limited to one repo that expire, and turn on secret scanning, push protection and branch protection.

items.title: Lock Down Dropbox
items.problem: A client handoff folder has a public edit link, an upload request is still open, and tax and financial files sit in a brand folder.
items.fix: Remove the public edit link, close the upload request, and move the tax and financial files to a private folder.

items.title: No Shared Passwords Between Sites
items.problem: One password is shared between the portfolio dashboard and the smartupkeep.ai gate.
items.fix: Give each its own unique password.

items.title: Protect The Open Submit Points
items.problem: The Submit receiver and WellNest Team Chat accept posts from anyone.
items.fix: Add rate limits and real authentication.

items.title: Sign Out Of The Shared Browser
items.problem: Your Instagram session is signed in on the shared computer browser that every agent uses.
items.fix: Sign it out and give agents only the access they need. You approve anything agents publish, send, pay for or delete, to guard against hidden instructions on web pages.

items.title: Protect The Brand And The Code
items.problem: No trademark is filed, the SMART UPKEEP name has conflicts, and there are no NDAs or IP-assignment agreements.
items.fix: Run a full trademark search, decide who owns the IP, and get contractors to sign.

items.title: Ready Before Member Data Arrives
items.problem: Real member data is coming, but there is no insurance, privacy policy, terms or breach plan yet.
items.fix: Get cyber and liability insurance, a privacy policy and terms, a breach plan (Michigan MCL 445.72), Stripe-hosted checkout, and collect less data.

items.title: Take Down Old Public Copies
items.problem: Old public copies remain: an earlier walk-through app on another GitHub account and Netlify copies.
items.fix: Take them down after you confirm.

items.title: Backups And A Monthly Review
items.problem: There is no regular backup of repos and key data, and no regular security check.
items.fix: Set up backups and a monthly security review.
